segments.he: גְּמָ׳ תַּנְיָא: הַנּוֹדֵר ״עַד הַקַּיִץ״ בַּגָּלִיל, וְיָרַד לָעֲמָקִים, אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁהִגִּיעַ הַקַּיִץ בָּעֲמָקִים — אָסוּר עַד שֶׁיַּגִּיעַ הַקַּיִץ בַּגָּלִיל.
segments.en: «GEMARA:» «It is taught» in a baraita: With regard to «one who vows until the summer in the Galilee and» subsequently «descends to the valleys, even if the summer» season «has» already «arrived in the valleys,» the subject of his vow remains «forbidden» to him «until summer arrives in the Galilee,» in accordance with the mishna’s ruling that the duration of a vow is in accordance with the place where it was made.

moves.summary: illustrates the mishna's 'according to the place of his vow'

edges.about: one who vows 'until summer' in the Galilee remains bound until summer arrives in the Galilee

positions.claim: the vow follows the place where it was made
